</div></div></div><div class="wpb_column vc_column_container vc_col-sm-12 vc_col-lg-6"><div class="vc_column-inner"><div class="wpb_wrapper"><div class="qodef-elements-holder   qodef-one-column  qodef-responsive-mode-768 " ><div class="qodef-eh-item    "  data-item-class="qodef-eh-custom-7837" data-1400-1600="139px 5px 0 0" data-1025-1399="84px 0 0" data-769-1024="75px 0 0" data-681-768="75px 0 0" data-680="77px 0 0">
	<div class="qodef-eh-item-inner">
		<div class="qodef-eh-item-content qodef-eh-custom-7837" style="padding: 155px 5px 0 0">
			<div class="qodef-section-title-holder  " >
	<div class="qodef-st-inner">
                    <span class="qodef-st-background-text" style="text-align: left"></span>
        					<h1 class="qodef-st-title" >
				Book &amp; Contact Now!			</h1>
		                        <span class="qodef-st-caption" style="margin: 15px 0 0">We will try to answer within a day, but if the wind is good and we are out on the water all day long, it might take us a bit longer....</span>
        					</div>
</div><div class="vc_empty_space"   style="height: 31px"><span class="vc_empty_space_inner"></span></div><noscript class="ninja-forms-noscript-message">
	Notice: JavaScript is required for this content.</noscript>
<div id="nf-form-1-cont" class="nf-form-cont" aria-live="polite" aria-labelledby="nf-form-title-1" aria-describedby="nf-form-errors-1" role="form">

    <div class="nf-loading-spinner"></div>

</div>

        <script></script>

</div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div><div class="qodef-row-grid-section-wrapper "  ><div class="qodef-row-grid-section"><div class="vc_row wpb_row vc_row-fluid vc_custom_1636491460045" ><div class="wpb_column vc_column_container vc_col-sm-12"><div class="vc_column-inner"><div class="wpb_wrapper"><div class="qodef-section-title-holder  " style="text-align: center">
	<div class="qodef-st-inner">
        					<h2 class="qodef-st-title" >
				How to get to Urla Surf House?			</h2>
		        					</div>
</div><div class="vc_empty_space"   style="height: 32px"><span class="vc_empty_space_inner"></span></div><div class="qodef-accordion-holder qodef-ac-default  qodef-toggle qodef-ac-boxed  clearfix">
	<h5 class="qodef-accordion-title">
    <span class="qodef-accordion-mark">
		<span class="qodef_icon_plus icon_plus"></span>
		<span class="qodef_icon_minus icon_minus-06"></span>
	</span>
	<span class="qodef-tab-title">Flying</span>
</h5>
<div class="qodef-accordion-content">
	<div class="qodef-accordion-content-inner">
		
	<div class="wpb_text_column wpb_content_element" >
		<div class="wpb_wrapper">
			<p>From Izmir Adnan Menderes International airport to Urla Surf House, &#8211; You can rent a car: 40 minutes &#8211; We can arrange transfer in case you let us know in advance: 40 minutes &#8211; Public transportation: 1.5 – 2 hours</p>

		</div>
	</div>
	</div>
</div></div><div class="qodef-accordion-holder qodef-ac-default  qodef-toggle qodef-ac-boxed  clearfix">
	<h5 class="qodef-accordion-title">
    <span class="qodef-accordion-mark">
		<span class="qodef_icon_plus icon_plus"></span>
		<span class="qodef_icon_minus icon_minus-06"></span>
	</span>
	<span class="qodef-tab-title">Flying - Airport Transport</span>
</h5>
<div class="qodef-accordion-content">
	<div class="qodef-accordion-content-inner">
		
	<div class="wpb_text_column wpb_content_element" >
		<div class="wpb_wrapper">
			<p>If you need transfer from the airport, contact us in advance and we will arrange it for you.</p>

		</div>
	</div>
	</div>
</div></div><div class="qodef-accordion-holder qodef-ac-default  qodef-toggle qodef-ac-boxed  clearfix">
	<h5 class="qodef-accordion-title">
    <span class="qodef-accordion-mark">
		<span class="qodef_icon_plus icon_plus"></span>
		<span class="qodef_icon_minus icon_minus-06"></span>
	</span>
	<span class="qodef-tab-title">Driving</span>
</h5>
<div class="qodef-accordion-content">
	<div class="qodef-accordion-content-inner">
		
	<div class="wpb_text_column wpb_content_element" >
		<div class="wpb_wrapper">
			<p>From Izmir take Cesme highway. DON’T exit from Urla. Take Karaburun exit and head to Karaburun. Then take the next Karaburun exit and from the roundabout head to Gulbahce. Turn right after you pass Shell gas station on the right hand and then follow Urla Surf House signs!</p>

		</div>
	</div>
	</div>
</div></div><div class="qodef-accordion-holder qodef-ac-default  qodef-toggle qodef-ac-boxed  clearfix">
	<h5 class="qodef-accordion-title">
    <span class="qodef-accordion-mark">
		<span class="qodef_icon_plus icon_plus"></span>
		<span class="qodef_icon_minus icon_minus-06"></span>
	</span>
	<span class="qodef-tab-title">Public Transportation &amp; By Coach</span>
</h5>
<div class="qodef-accordion-content">
	<div class="qodef-accordion-content-inner">
		
	<div class="wpb_text_column wpb_content_element" >
		<div class="wpb_wrapper">
			<p>Public Transportation &#8211; From the airport: Take izban going to Aliaga direction and at Hilal station change to metro going to Fahrettin Altay direction. You should get off the metro at the last station Fahrettin Altay and take ‘iskele’ exit. After 200 meters you will see Uckuyular bus station on the right hand. You should take the small bus going to Gulbahce. &#8211; From Izmir: Take the small bus goes to Gulbahce from Uckuyular bus station. &#8211; From Urla: Take the small bus goes to Gulbahce from Urla bus station. By Coach During the season there are some companies who directly come to Urla bus station. If you come by bus to Urla, from the same station you should take the small bus goes to Gulbahce. Approximately it will take 15 minutes.</p>

		</div>
	</div>
	</div>
</div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div><div class="vc_row wpb_row vc_row-fluid" ><div class="wpb_column vc_column_container vc_col-sm-12"><div class="vc_column-inner"><div class="wpb_wrapper"><div class="vc_empty_space"   style="height: 32px"><span class="vc_empty_space_inner"></span></div><div class="wpb_gmaps_widget wpb_content_element"><div class="wpb_wrapper"><div class="wpb_map_wraper"><iframe src="https://www.google.com/maps/embed?pb=!1m18!1m12!1m3!1d3129.7849981610407!2d26.64841841533371!3d38.33080937966194!2m3!1f0!2f0!3f0!3m2!1i1024!2i768!4f13.1!3m3!1m2!1s0x14bb90e4273cc921%3A0xf71db67b1a22ce8f!2zR8O8bGJhaMOnZSwgMTIwNzUuIFNrLiBObzo0NiwgMzU0MzAgVXJsYS_EsHptaXI!5e0!3m2!1sen!2str!4v1618175900125!5m2!1sen!2str" width="600" height="450" style="border:0;" allowfullscreen="" loading="lazy"></iframe></div></div></div></div></div></div></div>
</div>					</div>
							</div>
		        	</div>
